name: Link Sanitizer
short: Sanitizes links before posting them in the server
description: Automatically sanitizes links before posting them in the server. This removes any link tracking and makes the links embed in Discord natively allowing users to view the content from within Discord.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any user data.
author: YourName
install_msg: Thank you for installing the Link Sanitizer cog! This cog will automatically sanitize links before posting them in the server, removing any tracking and allowing for native Discord embeds.
